description: This file defines data structures and functions for working with EWAH compressed bitmaps, including creation, serialization, bit manipulation, and conversion between bitmap formats.

classes.name: ewah_bitmap
classes.description: Represents an EWAH compressed bitmap with buffer management.

classes.name: ewah_iterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing an uncompressed view of an EWAH bitmap.

classes.name: ewah_or_iterator
classes.description: Iterator for performing logical OR over multiple EWAH bitmaps.

classes.name: bitmap
classes.description: Uncompressed bitmap structure for efficient compression into EWAH format.

methods.name: ewah_pool_new
methods.description: Creates a new EWAH bitmap pool.

methods.name: ewah_pool_free
methods.description: Frees an EWAH bitmap pool.

methods.name: ewah_new
methods.description: Allocates a new EWAH compressed bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_free
methods.description: Frees memory associated with an EWAH bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_serialize_to
methods.description: Serializes an EWAH bitmap to a custom output function.

methods.name: ewah_serialize_strbuf
methods.description: Serializes an EWAH bitmap into a string buffer.

methods.name: ewah_read_mmap
methods.description: Reads an EWAH bitmap from memory-mapped data.

methods.name: ewah_checksum
methods.description: Computes checksum of an EWAH bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_each_bit
methods.description: Calls a callback for each set bit in the bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_set
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_iterator_init
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for uncompressed traversal of a bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_iterator_next
methods.description: Retrieves the next word in uncompressed form from the iterator.

methods.name: ewah_or_iterator_init
methods.description: Initializes an OR iterator over multiple bitmaps.

methods.name: ewah_or_iterator_next
methods.description: Retrieves the next word from the OR iterator.

methods.name: ewah_or_iterator_release
methods.description: Releases resources used by the OR iterator.

methods.name: ewah_xor
methods.description: Performs XOR operation between two EWAH bitmaps.

methods.name: ewah_add_empty_words
methods.description: Adds empty words to a bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_add_dirty_words
methods.description: Adds dirty (raw) words to a bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_add
methods.description: Adds a single word to a bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_new
methods.description: Creates a new uncompressed bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_word_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a bitmap with specified word capacity.

methods.name: bitmap_dup
methods.description: Duplicates an existing bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_set
methods.description: Sets a bit in the uncompressed bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_unset
methods.description: Unsets a bit in the uncompressed bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a bit in the bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_free
methods.description: Frees memory of a bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_equals
methods.description: Checks equality between two bitmaps.

methods.name: bitmap_equals_ewah
methods.description: Checks equality between a bitmap and an EWAH bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_is_subset
methods.description: Checks if one bitmap is a subset of another.

methods.name: ewah_bitmap_is_subset
methods.description: Checks if an EWAH bitmap is a subset of a bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_to_ewah
methods.description: Converts a bitmap to an EWAH bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_to_bitmap
methods.description: Converts an EWAH bitmap to a bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_and_not
methods.description: Performs AND NOT operation between two bitmaps.

methods.name: bitmap_or_ewah
methods.description: Performs OR operation between a bitmap and an EWAH bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_or
methods.description: Performs OR operation between two bitmaps.

methods.name: bitmap_popcount
methods.description: Counts the number of set bits in a bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_bitmap_popcount
methods.description: Counts the number of set bits in an EWAH bitmap.

methods.name: bitmap_is_empty
methods.description: Checks if a bitmap has no set bits.
